_comment: MS1.1 required-component inventory (plan rev 6-10, macOS plan:396-401; RoseCat 5968/5974/5995/6002).
The MS1 bundle ships the browser AND, since MS1b (option d), the WKWebView ObjC shim as a separate
dylib (build.zig configureMacosBackend builds it with the Apple toolchain so a code-signed x86_64
binary runs; the exe links it via @executable_path/../Frameworks). Both are native fat Mach-Os.
'complete' means every native Mach-O the bundle actually ships. The census (mac_universal_test.py)
scans the whole bundle for every Mach-O and requires each fat (x86_64 + arm64) and every role
present at its exact path_glob; the fail-closed probe rejects any file `file` cannot classify.
The empty 'resources' list is accepted by the typed phase gate (mac_resource_compat.py
--milestone MS1) ONLY for this exact browser+shim shape; see resource_phase. The agent-runtime
roles (python-runtime, claude-cli as fat Mach-O; the generated zb-claude launcher + runtime files
as byte-compat resources) are added to THIS inventory in MS5's red, where macOS provisioning
first installs them and the two-tree resource_compat oracle runs on the per-arch trees (MS5.1c).
